01

Proposed features

Two model options · scope to be aligned
MULTI-SCENARIO VLM

In-cabin &
exterior intelligence

Understand the road environment and passenger needs.

0.9B VLM → 1.2B VLM

Exterior

Intelligent lights
GeelyFront camera

Recognize fog, heavy rain and heavy snow through the front camera to support adaptive vehicle lighting under OEM-defined rules.

Adaptive window control
GeelyFront camera

Recognize tunnels and adverse weather to support window adjustments through Aptiv’s vehicle-control logic.

Obstacle detection
GACAVM

On entry, use the left and right AVM fisheye cameras to detect nearby obstacles. Aptiv can trigger a surround-view display and spoken alert when an obstacle is detected.

In-cabin

Child & pet care
GACOMS

Detect unsafe child behavior and recommend seat-specific child locks. Detect pets and combine recognition with door, window and ventilation signals to support care reminders.

Left-behind object monitoring
GACOMS

Detect personal belongings left in the cabin and remind occupants to take them when exiting.

Welcome experience
with restricted labelsOMS

Personalize greetings on entry using a restricted set of labels for cues such as weather, clothing and departure time.

PARKED VEHICLE

Parked-vehicle
protection

Understand events around a parked vehicle.

0.9B dedicated Sentry model

Smart Centry

SAIC

Describe sentry events and provide risk alerts.

02

Responsibilities & resource footprint

Proposed ownership · target-board validation

VLM architecture & delivery boundary

ModelBest delivers the model and its outputs. Aptiv owns the surrounding engineering and vehicle integration.

ModelBest · model & outputsAptiv · engineering
Delivery interfaceModelBest: model package, model I/O specification and agreed outputs.Aptiv: SDK/runtime integration, scheduling, input pipelines, application logic and vehicle execution.

Conceptual architecture. The VLM accepts images plus a prompt through one model interface. Exact model internals and output fields will be aligned with the selected model. Application labels illustrate the integration structure, not a commitment to deploy both model options together.

Data collection starts in Month 2, followed by cleaning and annotation in Month 3. Training, fine-tuning, quantization and deployment take place in Month 4; model refinement and integration support continue through Months 5–6. Calendar dates and delivery prerequisites will be aligned at kickoff.
